name: review
summary: Review a diff, PR or whole codebase through several lenses and keep only findings that survive a check

steps.goal: List the changed files (or the areas of the codebase) and group them for review
steps.verify: the groups cover every changed file

steps.goal: Review one group or one lens (correctness, security, performance, tests) and report findings with file:line
steps.fan_out: one subtask per lens or file group, ids lens-<name>; raise security lenses to opus

steps.goal: Try to reproduce each critical and high finding; lower or drop the ones that do not hold
steps.verify: a verdict per finding with the command
